title: Garlic Butter Pasta
blurb: Five ingredients, one pan, and better than it has any right to be.
method: Boil the pasta in well-salted water. Save a cup of the water before draining.
Melt the butter in a pan over low heat. Add the garlic and cook gently until soft, not brown.
Add the drained pasta and a splash of the pasta water. Toss until glossy.
Stir through the parsley. Serve with parmesan and lots of pepper.

title: Overnight Oats
ingredients: Fruit, nuts, or seeds to top
method: Stir the oats, milk, yoghurt and honey together in a jar.
Cover and leave in the fridge overnight.
In the morning, loosen with a little more milk and add your toppings.
